S1 — NON-MATERIAL (test-evidence nit), packages/core/test/levelUpSpellSelection.test.ts:1239-1244. Concrete scenario: the Fiend warlock fixture is level 2 with three known spells and preview receives choices={}; its 2->3 transition requires both Pact Boon and a fourth known spell. preview.ok is therefore false, changeSet is undefined, and the alwaysPrepared assertion passes without exercising a successful level-up. Suggested improvement: supply level.3.feature.warlock-pact-boon.pact-boon=[pact-boon:pact-of-the-blade] and level.3.spells.known=[spell:darkness], assert preview.ok, then check the successful result (or apply and persisted state). This is not a runtime or acceptance-criteria defect: the shared prepared-caster gate is correct, creation already exercises Fiend exclusion, and a separate real-resolver preview/apply probe with those valid decisions confirmed no automatic Fiend grants. Suggested evidence is one generalized caster-kind exclusion invariant, proportionate to this cheap shared boundary; no additional proof framework is warranted.
